messages.author: 0141b24755b40cf8
messages.subject: shapes do not match legend
parts:
Hi all,

I am just starting with ggplot2, so forgive me if I am asking a stupid
question. I have a data set that I am plotting as a scatter plot and
I have created a legend with symbols for each of the points based on a
priori classification into one of 6 groups, which I have as a column
in the data set. However, the fifth symbol, a square with and x
inside it, plots with either an x inside or a circle. Is this an
error, or is it providing addition information not in the legend? If
it is not an error, how does one make the symbol consistent.

Thanks for any help,

Wade
